title: Bubble up role Tool feedback: auto-file the safe items, queue the rest as owner decisions

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Roles report Tool feedback (see slicer s453, the relay report-shape slice). ork should parse it, drop duplicates, file clear low-risk items itself (a note or slice on the tool's project) and bubble design-level or costly ones into Needs you as an adj question with options and a recommendation, so the owner or the delegated orchestrator decides in one place. Prefer deterministic code over AI calls; human use stays first.
